title: Emerald Demon and Mystic
description: A large green geometric demon with horns, glowing white eyes and a wide toothy grin floats in the sky above a bald woman with colorful facial markings. The woman stands on ancient stone steps, wearing a green and yellow geometric dress and holding a glowing orb in her outstretched hand.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene featuring a massive muscular green geometric demon with horns and glowing white eyes grinning from the sky above, while a bald woman with colorful face paint and a green and yellow geometric dress stands on ancient stone ruins extending her hand to hold a glowing orb, golden flowing energy streams between them, misty landscape with distant city and house at sunset
